expectations.text: Offers two or three candidate one-liners for the point, rather than one
expectations.evidence: brief.md lists A/B/C: 'A. Your root CLAUDE.md is the one file...', 'B. Moving workflows into skills swapped...', 'C. Past a certain length...'

expectations.text: Names the reader: who they are, what they believe now, what should change
expectations.evidence: Reader section: Who 'A developer who uses Claude Code... on a real, long-running repo'; Believes now 'More rules there means more control'; Should leave with 'A rule for sorting what stays in CLAUDE.md and what moves'
Tension section: 'The fix everyone reaches for, adding one more rule to CLAUDE.md, is the thing that broke it... The reader is choosing between two failure modes'

expectations.text: Proposes at least two arcs written as numbered beats, and recommends one with a reason
expectations.evidence: Recommended Build log as 10 numbered beats; alternatives sketched as beat sequences: Three attempts '900-line CLAUDE.md -> [intermediate fix] -> skills', Single insight 'default -> problem -> small change -> before/after -> when to use or skip -> one line'. Reason: 'Build log is the pattern built for "here's what I did, concretely, and here's what isn't right yet"'

expectations.text: Marks turning points as what the reader should see or do, not how to build a visual
expectations.evidence: Turning points framed as reader perception: 'the reader should see a rule sitting deep in a very long file', 'see the failure move rather than vanish'; no build instructions

expectations.text: Includes honesty beats (what isn't solved or what went wrong first)
expectations.evidence: Honesty beats section: 'What isn't solved: skill triggering reliability', 'What went wrong first: the 900-line file itself', 'Sample size: one client repo. Say so.'

expectations.text: Marks missing evidence as 'author to supply' (or equivalent) instead of inventing facts, numbers or anecdotes
expectations.evidence: Gaps marked 'Author to supply' throughout the beat table (e.g. beat 2 'One specific rule that was ignored' -> 'Author to supply'); hook 2 guarded '(Only if "follows it better" is true)'. Cross-references (Karpathy ~60 lines, post two promising tags/global memory) verified in published posts

expectations.text: Contains no drafted body paragraphs of the post
expectations.evidence: No post prose; only one-liners, emphasis line, titles and one-sentence hook options

expectations.text: Argues the one-post-vs-series decision from the evidence in the notes
expectations.evidence: 'Why not a series: ... Right now you can answer one question... The second question ("do skills actually trigger reliably?") is the open one, and you don't have the evidence for it yet.'

expectations.text: Plans an honesty beat around skills not triggering reliably
expectations.evidence: Beat 7 'The trade' and beat 8 'What's not right yet. Triggering reliability'; 'This is the post's main honesty beat and should be planned as beat 7-8'
